note: The closest match to the stated ICP anywhere in this batch, and close to a literal reading of it — the ICP names 'a physician' and he is a practising medical oncologist. Income is explicitly unconstrained in his own words: 'The money aspect is not that big of a problem. It's just that it's a risk.' Health is the neglected area rather than a crisis — no conditions, a recent DEXA scan showing acceptable muscle mass and visceral fat, and a specific 9-14 kg abdominal-fat target. He is emphatically not deconditioned: he finished a marathon last year and walks 15,000 steps on running days. And he framed the goal as good-to-great longevity himself — adding resistance training before turning 50 to slow muscle and bone loss, not seeking rescue. That this textbook-fit prospect did not close, and that the rep resorted to inventing a $1,200 tier to try to move him, is the finding: the blocker was certainty and evidence, not qualification. It is worth setting against the corpus pattern that the calls which do close sit outside the stated ICP.
